ezekiel.42.p1.b1.text: Then the man led me out northward into the outer court … he brought me to the group of chambers … Gallery faced gallery in three levels …

ezekiel.42.p1.b2.text: … they have left behind the garments in which they minister, for these are holy. They are to put on other clothes before they approach the places that are for the people.

ezekiel.42.p1.b3.text: Now when the man had finished measuring the interior of the temple area, he led me out by the gate that faced east, and he measured the area all around:

ezekiel.42.p1.b4.text: So he measured the area on all four sides. It had a wall all around, five hundred cubits long and five hundred cubits wide, to separate the holy from the common.
